prerequisites: Knowledge of constructive 'setting up' (manual or CAD) according to European normatives.

learning_outcomes.text: The student will acquire the methodological tools for the systematic design of the industrial product.

The student will be instructed and will experiment with the most advanced techniques of product development through practical exercises, cultured in the organizational reality of a technical office dedicated to the design of functional groups and articulated mechanical parts.

syllabus_topics: The industrial product and the types
Mass production and the customer-driven product
The life cycle of the product
PDM / PLM systems and their use in the project
Functional design and management of tree groups in the DMU
Development of the product for the removal of shavings and product development for production through additive manufacturing: geometric problems (latex structures, etc. ...)
Management of variants and product range
Design of the range variants and their integration in PLM systems
Product standardization through implementation of model reusage supported by PLM systems.
Methods of optimization of the product and of the geometry
teaching_methods: Lectures in the classroom with the use of transparencies and other digital media
Exercises carried out by the lecturer
Exercises aimed at developing some mechanical components
Assigned exercises to deepen product development techniques

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (using a CAD system, creating a mechanical assembly and components, selecting commercial components, producing at least one technical drawing)
Oral exam (covering theoretical part of the course, at least two questions on different topics)

assessment_rules: The grade, expressed on a 30-point scale, will be assigned overall based on both the written and oral exams. The written exam is two-and-a-half-hours, taken individually, using a CAD system. The oral exam will take place on a different date, covering the theoretical part of the course with at least two questions.
